name: web-team-directory-with-collapsible-departments-and-status-dots
title: 'Team directory' with collapsible Design, Engineering and Marketing groups, counts, a vertical guide line and green, amber and grey status dots
whatItIs: A white column with a bold title and three groups, each with a person icon, a bold department name, a small grey count pill and an up chevron, followed by an indented list on a thin vertical line of names with roles and small green, amber or grey dots.
whatItMeans: Clear and calm; nesting and dots show structure and presence together.
techniques: Indent lists on a thin guide line.

vocabulary.definition: A heading that expands to show its items.
A small capsule with a number.
A thin vertical line marking indentation.
